subject.entry_points_source: docs/jwt/api.rst, docs/jws/api.rst and docs/jwe/api.rst (automodule of jose.jwt, jose.jws and jose.jwe): jwt.decode, 'Verifies a JWT string's signature and validates reserved claims.' (jose/jwt.py, line 67); jws.verify, 'Verifies a JWS string's signature.' (jose/jws.py, line 53); jwe.decrypt, 'Decrypts a JWE compact serialized string and returns the plaintext.', which raises JWEError 'If there is an exception verifying the token.' (jose/jwe.py, lines 61 and 71-72). docs/jwk/index.rst shows key.verify(message, decoded_sig) under 'Verifying token signatures'. Entry points are names, so the same names elsewhere in the package count too.
subject.name: python-jose
subject.package_source: setup.cfg, [options] packages = find: (line 34) and [options.packages.find] exclude = tests* (lines 52-54): the package jose, with its subpackage jose.backends, at the root of the repository
subject.rejection_bases_source: The docstrings of the entry points name JWTError, ExpiredSignatureError and JWTClaimsError (jose/jwt.py, lines 120-123), JWSError (jose/jws.py, lines 64-65) and JWEError (jose/jwe.py, lines 71-72). In jose/exceptions.py, JWSError (line 5), JWTError (line 17) and JWEError (line 33) inherit from JOSEError (line 1), and JWTClaimsError and ExpiredSignatureError from JWTError (lines 21 and 25): JOSEError is the base class of all of them and of every other exception class of the module.

At that commit, jose/__init__.py, line 1, sets __version__ = "3.5.0", which setup.cfg, line 3, makes the version of the distribution.
subject.suite_runs_source: tox.ini: for Python 3.12, the environments py312-base, py312-cryptography-only, py312-pycryptodome-norsa and py312-compatibility ([gh-actions], line 13; .github/workflows/ci.yml, line 44, runs tox), each with 1 pytest call from the root of the repository ([testenv:basecommand], line 20). compatibility installs the extras cryptography and pycryptodome (lines 29-32 and 56) and gives no marker expression (line 52), so its call runs every test that the other 3 select with -m (lines 46, 48 and 50); those 3 run in environments that lack backends, the extras (base), ecdsa and rsa (cryptography-only, line 41) or rsa (pycryptodome-norsa, line 43), which the 1 environment of a subject cannot be. The suite run is the call of compatibility, without its coverage options, on tests, the directory of every test file.
subject.test_directories_source: pytest.ini sets no testpaths, and pytest reads it ahead of the [tool:pytest] section of setup.cfg (pytest 9.2.0, _pytest/config/findpaths.py, lines 240-252: the configuration files in precedence order, pytest.ini before setup.cfg); tox.ini, [testenv:basecommand] (line 20), runs pytest without a path from the root of the repository, and every test file of the repository is under tests/ (git ls-files at the commit). setup.cfg, [tool:pytest], names the same directory: testpaths = tests (line 72).
